title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer


Salary: Up to £85,000

Location: Fully remote – UK

The Role

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build and deliver AI-powered features for a large-scale enterprise SaaS platform. You’ll work closely with Product, Design and Engineering to turn ideas into reliable, production-ready solutions that improve the user experience.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys experimenting with AI, building prototypes and taking them through to production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and deploy AI-powered features from prototype to production.
  • Develop LLM integrations, agents, tool use and orchestration workflows.
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to identify meaningful AI opportunities.
  • Contribute to AI development practices, internal tooling and technical decisions.
Essential Skills
  • Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, using tools such as OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain or LlamaIndex.
  • Strong backend development skills, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Full-stack experience, with some familiarity with React.
  • Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous programming and databases.
  • Understanding of software testing, deployment and production-ready development.
  • A practical, hands-on approach to AI experimentation and AI-assisted coding.
Desirable Experience
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI agents.
  • AWS, particularly Lambda, SQS/SNS, Bedrock or S3.
  • Vector databases, embeddings and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Prompt engineering and LLM evaluation.
  • Docker, CI/CD and multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • AI safety, governance and responsible AI practices.

Interested in building practical AI solutions that make a real difference? We’re keen to hear from engineers who enjoy experimenting with emerging technologies and turning them into useful, scalable products.
